subject: Closure Conductor: MSA / DPA / Order Form takt plan & checkpoints
messages:
From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@cardinalmed.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@cardinalmed.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardinalmed.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff + legal sequencing (first pass)

Evelyn — thanks for the packet and the call yesterday. Team reviewed the MPA template and the DPA checklist. Two quick items from legal/procurement: 

1) CardinalMed needs the DPA redlines returned in a consolidated PDF with change highlights (we prefer PDF for our intake).
2) Procurement asked for a gating plan that ties the pilot acceptance milestone to the signed order form (they need an explicit acceptance window and rollback clause).

I've attached our internal redlines (we'll send the formal markups after we sync with tech). High level ask: can Redwood provide a 2-week takt plan that spells out stakeholder approvals (legal, privacy, procurement, SOC evidence) and exact deliverable dates so we can align internal sign-off windows?

Tom (cc'd) will own procurement timing. Can Evelyn or your legal rep call Tom next week for a quick alignment?

Best,
Anita
Sr. Procurement Manager | CardinalMed

Attachments: CardinalMed_DPA_notes_v1.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@cardinalmed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff + legal sequencing (first pass)

Anita — thanks, and appreciate the clarity. We're preparing a concise takt plan (2-week cadence) that maps out: 

- Week 0 (today — Wed): Redwood delivers consolidated MPA spreadsheet + DPA redlines (pdf + tracked doc)
- Week 1: Cardinal legal review window (3 business days) + procurement identification of PO/order form approvers
- Week 2: SOC evidence handoff & technical acceptance criteria review (2 business days)
- Week 3: Final signature window — target DocuSign circulation on Friday of week 3

Two items we need from your side ASAP to make this deterministic:
- Confirm the acceptance test owner (name + email) and the exact acceptance window length (e.g., 5 business days).
- Preferred DocuSign routing order (legal -> procurement -> exec) — we can model the envelope accordingly.

Karthik — looping you in for the DPA redline reconciliation; Laura and Rachel will coordinate evidence packaging and the order form template. We'll attach the first-draft MPA workbook to this thread by EOD.

I attached: Redwood_MPA_v3.xlsx (draft) and OrderForm_TermSheet_0619.docx.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Growth Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v3.xlsx; OrderForm_TermSheet_0619.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@cardinalmed.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@cardinalmed.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff + legal sequencing (first pass)

Anita / Tom — quick update from legal: attached is Redwood's consolidated DPA with inline comments and a separate PDF that highlights the three risk items we expect Cardinal to confirm: 

1) Data residency carve (we proposed EU-only subprocessor restriction for EU data; Cardinal to confirm whether US patient data needs special handling).
2) Incident notification SLAs — Redwood proposes 24-hour detection + 48-hour remediation notification cadence; Cardinal legal proposed 24/24 for high-severity (we've added a comms fallback).
3) Audit rights — we suggested scoped, quarterly evidence exports rather than open annual audits for pilot phase.

Operationally, to satisfy procurement's ask for tie-to-acceptance, proposed acceptance flow in the MPA workbook: 
- Acceptance runbook doc (deliverable) completed by Redwood -> Cardinal test owner validates within 5 business days -> successful sign-off triggers order form invoice issuance.

Tom — if procurement needs a different cadence, propose we capture that as an explicit variance in the MPA and lock it before DocuSign. 

Evelyn — Laura / Rachel, next steps: produce the evidence bundle (SOC summary, retention policy, KMS overview) and export as single PDF (DPA intake friendly). I will consolidate legal changes and produce DPA_redlines_Anita.pdf by EOD tomorrow.

-Karthik
General Counsel (acting) | Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_consolidated_tracked.docx; DPA_redlines_Anita.pdf

From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@cardinalmed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@cardinalmed.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardinalmed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff + legal sequencing (first pass)

Thanks everyone — that flow looks good and it's great to see the acceptance-runbook tie to invoicing. Two clarifications before we push to DocuSign: 

• Acceptance window: confirmed 5 business days; acceptance owner will be Dr. Maya Rios (maya.rios@cardinalmed.com).
• DocuSign routing: legal -> procurement -> CFO (Tom will provide CFO contact; I'll follow up).

Procurement asks that the DPA redlines are returned as a single annotated PDF (thanks, Karthik). If Redwood can deliver the evidence bundle and the consolidated DPA redlines by tomorrow EOD, we'll aim to have an internal approval through procurement/legal by end of next week and circulate DocuSign the following Monday. That would align with our pilot start target the week after.

Action items recap: 
- Redwood: deliver DPA_redlines_Anita.pdf (Karthik) + evidence bundle PDF (Laura/Rachel) — due EOD 2025-06-26
- CardinalMed: provide CFO contact for routing + acceptance owner confirmation (Anita) — provided above

I'll mark this as our official gating takt in HubSpot once we have the PDFs. Appreciated.

Best,
Anita
Sr. Procurement Manager | CardinalMed

Attachments referenced: none (we will accept your PDFs)
